description: 台灣糖業公司加油站自助加油區營業據點 [fuel stations and oil] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 台灣糖業股份有限公司. 配合公司多角化經營政策及活化公司土地，台糖公司於1995年成立加油站籌設推動小組及因應國內加油站市場自由化，建立符合環保及安全的示範站點，提供消費者便利及溫馨的交易環境並創造在地社區就業機會，善盡國營企業社會責任。 從1997年開始迄今事業部為了擴大經營規模及績效，開始增建加油站，至今共73站。 因應時代變遷，為了符合更多族群的需求及人力... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 台灣糖業股份有限公司. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2024-09-03 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
